描述_EN: . the all over pattern of petalled rosettes are made by the technique of resist dyeing. the textile was recovered from the site of karakhoja. the site is part of an area of central asia we now call the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia, from china to europe. karakhoja lies south of turfan, towards the eastern end of the northern silk road. it is unclear what the piece would have been used for, although it is most likely to have been part of a burial shroud. camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed the goods from oasis to oasis. the victoria and albert museum has around 700 ancient and medieval textiles recovered by stein at the beginning of the twentieth century. this textile was brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862-1943). the most notable item traded was silk. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas – while silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. the turkic uygurs then made karakhoja their capital. some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. this textile are made up of several pieces of silk stitched together. the chinese established a military post at karakhoja in the fourth century ad, but it fell to successive nomadic groups until the chinese regained it during the tang dynasty (618-907 ad).
描述_ZN: . 遍布花瓣的玫瑰花纹是用抵制染色的技术制作的。 该纺织品是从karakhoja遗址中发现的。 该遗址是中亚地区的一部分，我们现在称之为丝绸之路，这是一系列横跨亚洲的陆上贸易路线，从中国到欧洲。 卡拉霍贾位于吐鲁番南部，靠近北方丝绸之路的东端。 目前还不清楚这块织物的用途，尽管它最有可能是裹尸布的一部分。 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递货物。 年，维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆有大约700件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初找到的。 年，这个纺织品被探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：丝绸之路对思想交流也很重要--当丝绸纺织品从中国向西运输时，佛教也通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 土耳其维吾尔人随后将卡拉霍亚作为他们的首都。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这种纺织品是由几块丝绸缝合而成的。 中国人在公元四世纪在卡拉霍贾建立了一个军事哨所，但它被连续的游牧民族占领，直到中国人在唐朝（公元618-907年）重新夺回它。
